Character models (characters/), weapon models (weapons/) and prop models
(props/) are sourced from Kenney (www.kenney.nl):

  - "Blocky Characters" - https://kenney.nl/assets/blocky-characters
  - "Blaster Kit"        - https://kenney.nl/assets/blaster-kit

License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0) - https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Free for personal, educational, and commercial use. Attribution is not
required but is appreciated: credit "Kenney" / www.kenney.nl.

Character texture variants were selected (not modified) from the pack's
existing 18 palette options to fit in-game roles (teammate/suspect/hostage/
civilian). Weapon models are recolored at runtime in Renderer3D.js.
